subject.title: [Feature]: Guided CLI onboarding with live AI verification (macOS parity) and classic fallback

question: Should flagless interactive CLI onboarding switch from chat-first setup to a deterministic guided verifier that reuses `detectSetupInference` and `activateSetupInference`?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but changing the default first-run CLI UX and provider-auth persistence behavior is a public setup contract decision protected by the `maintainer` label.

options.title: Adopt guided verifier after PR blockers
options.body: Make guided live verification the CLI default once the linked PR's credential durability, workspace verification, and mergeability blockers are resolved.

options.title: Ship guided verifier as opt-in
options.body: Keep chat-first onboarding as the default and expose the guided verifier behind an explicit command or flag until more live proof accumulates.

options.title: Narrow to verification repair
options.body: Keep the current flow shape and only add live verification or recovery handling around the existing setup path.

recommendation.title: Adopt guided verifier after PR blockers
recommendation.body: Make guided live verification the CLI default once the linked PR's credential durability, workspace verification, and mergeability blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the linked issue/PR context and the recent onboarding parity surfaces that define the requested behavior.
